'''Furkan Aldemir''' (born August 9, 1991) is a Turkish professional [[basketball]] player who last played for [[Darüşşafaka S.K.|Darüşşafaka]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL) and the [[EuroLeague]]. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=10}}, he mainly plays the [[power forward]] position, but he can also play as a [[Center (basketball)|center]] if needed.

==Professional career==

===Turkey===
Aldemir made his professional debut in the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish Basketball Super League]] with [[Karşıyaka Basket|Karşıyaka]] during the 2007–08 season. In June 2011, he signed a four-year deal with [[Galatasaray S.K. (men's basketball)|Galatasaray]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Galatasaray tabs prospect Furkan Aldemir|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/86640/galatasaray-tabs-prospect-furkan-aldemir.html|access-date=December 2, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=June 21, 2011}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Galatasaray made official the arrival of Furkan Aldemir|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/86846/galatasaray-made-official-the-arrival-of-furkan-aldemir.html|access-date=December 2, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=June 28, 2011}}</ref> In May 2014, he signed a new three-year, €3.9 million net income contract with Galatasaray.<ref>{{Cite news | url = http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/120668/galatasaray-agreed-with-furkan-aldemir-on-a-new-three-year-deal.html | title = Galatasaray agreed with Furkan Aldemir on a new three-year deal | work = Sportando.com | date = May 26, 2014 | access-date = May 28, 2014}}</ref> On November 24, 2014, he announced via [[Facebook]], of his decision to leave Galatasaray, in pursuit of an [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] contract.<ref>{{cite news|title=Furkan Aldemir announces on Facebook his decision to leave Galatasaray to join the NBA|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/142402/furkan-aldemir-announces-on-facebook-his-decision-to-leave-galatasaray-to-join-the-nba.html|access-date=December 2, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=November 24, 2014}}</ref> On December 1, 2014, he officially parted ways with Galatasaray.<ref>{{cite news|title=Furkan Aldemir and Galatasaray part ways|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/143247/furkan-aldemir-and-galatasaray-part-ways.html|access-date=December 2, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=December 1, 2014}}</ref>

===NBA===
[[File:Furkan Aldemir 76ers.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Aldemir with the 76ers]]
Aldemir was an early entrant in the [[2012 NBA draft]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Eleven early entry candidates withdraw from 2012 NBA Draft |url=https://pr.nba.com/2012-nba-draft-early-entry-candidates/ |website=NBA Communications |access-date=December 12, 2023 |date=June 19, 2012}}</ref> and was selected by the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] with the 53rd overall pick.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/clippers/features/clippers-choose-aldemir-patten-120628.html|title=CLIPPERS CHOOSE FURKAN ALDEMIR WITH 53RD PICK IN DRAFT|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=June 28, 2012|access-date=July 15, 2013}}</ref> His rights were subsequently traded to the [[Houston Rockets]] in a four-team trade.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/8113523/lamar-odom-traded-los-angeles-clippers-mo-williams-utah-jazz-four-team-trade|work=ESPN.com|title=Lamar Odom traded to Clippers|date=June 30, 2012|access-date=July 15, 2013}}</ref> On July 13, 2013, his rights were traded, along with [[Royce White]], to the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/130713-aldemir-white-trade|title=Sixers Acquire Rights to 21-year-old Center/Forward Furkan Aldemir of Turkey|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|access-date=July 14, 2013|date=July 13, 2013}}</ref>

On December 15, 2014, Aldemir signed with the Philadelphia 76ers.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/141215-aldemir-press-release|title=Sixers Sign Rights-held Furkan Aldemir|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|access-date=December 15, 2014|date=December 15, 2014}}</ref> He made his NBA debut the same day, against the [[Boston Celtics]], recording 2 points, 2 rebounds, and 1 assist, in a 105–87 loss.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20141215/BOSPHI/gameinfo.html|title=Olynyk scores 30 in Celtics' 105-87 win over 76ers|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|access-date=December 16, 2014|date=December 15, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141227232057/http://www.nba.com/games/20141215/BOSPHI/gameinfo.html|archive-date=December 27, 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> On October 26, 2015, he was waived by the 76ers.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/philadelphia-76ers-waive-five|title=PHILADELPHIA 76ERS WAIVE FIVE|date=October 26, 2015|work=NBA.com|access-date=October 26, 2015}}</ref>

===Return to Europe===
On November 7, 2015, Aldemir signed a four-year contract with [[Darüşşafaka S.K.|Darüşşafaka]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Darussafaka Dogus signs Furkan Aldemir through 2019|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/181289/darussafaka-dogus-signs-furkan-aldemir-through-2019.html|access-date=7 November 2015|work=Sportando.com|date=7 November 2015}}</ref>

==International career==
Aldemir was a regular [[Turkey men's national under-20 basketball team|Turkish youth national team]] player, as he won a bronze medal at the [[2009 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.teamID_376.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2009.roundID_6637.coid_nLtNApPJJOkwIE6IAvue82.articleMode_on.html |work=FIBAEurope.com |title=TURKEY RUN AWAY WITH BRONZE MEDAL GAME |date=August 2, 2009 |access-date=November 25, 2014}}</ref> He also played at the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], where he averaged 11.6 rebounds per game. A year later, he played at the [[2011 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], where he averaged 14.8 points, 15.9 rebounds, 1.3 assists, and 1.7 blocks per game. He was named to the All-Tournament team for his performance. He went on to play for the senior men's [[Turkey national basketball team|Turkish national basketball team]] at the [[FIBA EuroBasket 2013 qualification]], and the [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup]].
